description: Official Problem 9 run. The working database was reset to the original, then the agent team (gpt-6-luna via Portkey) ran tickets 101, 102 and 103. Every payment was approved by a human, David Wallace, logged in on the dashboard. Source: output/audit_trail.json and data/campus_customs_new.db.

tickets.subject: 1 white Bulldog tee (CC-TEE-WHITE), size S
tickets.outcome: Size S is out of stock (0 on hand). The only apparel vendor, Bulldog Print Co, was blocked by overdue invoice #501 ($840). Oscar requested payment of #501, David Wallace approved it, and the vendor is now unblocked for a 5-day reprint. The customer got a delay note as a draft (never sent).

agent_contributions.boss: Michael Scott: read the ticket, delegated to Dwight, Oscar and Pam, set status waiting_on_human with a full note. Tools: get_ticket, get_ticket_board, get_cash_position, update_ticket_status.
agent_contributions.inventory: Dwight Schrute: confirmed 0 in stock (shortfall 1), identified Bulldog Print Co as the apparel vendor blocked by invoice #501 (3 days overdue), and asked Oscar to prepare the payment. Tool: check_stock_and_restock.
agent_contributions.accounting: Oscar Martinez: created payment request #1 (invoice #501, $840), avoided a duplicate on his second hand-off, and advised paying rent first ($3,400 → $1,000 → $160). Tools: get_cash_position, list_payment_requests, get_ticket, request_payment_approval, assess_payment_request.
agent_contributions.customer_service: Pam Beesly: saved draft #1 to the customer (out of stock, restock not confirmed, will follow up), not sent. Tools: list_drafts, save_draft_message.

human_approvals.reason: Yes, we need this to be paid to keep making money.

tickets.subject: Rent due for the Chapel Street shop (lease 1)
tickets.outcome: Rent of $2,400 was due 2026-09-02 (2 days after the shop's today). Oscar requested the rent payment, David Wallace approved it, and the lease's next due date moved to 2026-10-02. The landlord was not contacted.

agent_contributions.boss: Michael Scott: delegated to Darryl and Oscar, set status waiting_on_human. Tools: get_ticket, get_ticket_board, list_payment_requests, get_cash_position, update_ticket_status.
agent_contributions.accounting: Oscar Martinez: created payment request #2 (rent, $2,400), confirmed cash covers it ($3,400 → $1,000, or $160 with #501), caught the duplicate on his second hand-off. Tools: get_cash_position, check_rent_due, list_payment_requests, request_payment_approval, assess_payment_request.
agent_contributions.facilities: Darryl Philbin: confirmed lease 1 ($2,400 monthly, due 2026-09-02, 2 days away) and asked Oscar to prepare the rent request; made no landlord contact. Tool: check_rent_due.

human_approvals.what: Rent for the Chapel Street shop to Elm City Properties
human_approvals.reason: Yes, we can't work without the office.

tickets.subject: Bulk discount: 20 navy hoodies (CC-HOOD-NAVY), size M
tickets.outcome: The team approved a 10% bulk discount ($52.20 each vs. $22 cost: $30.20 margin, 57.9%). Only 8 of 20 are in stock; the 12-unit restock ($264) was deferred because, after rent and #501, cash would be $104 short. No payment was requested. The student group got a draft offer: take 8 now at $52.20 or wait (not sent).

agent_contributions.boss: Michael Scott: delegated to Dwight, Oscar and Pam, recorded the 10% discount as the business decision, set status in_progress then waiting_on_human. His deeper hand-off to Dwight was stopped by the delegation-depth guardrail. Tools: get_ticket, get_ticket_board, update_ticket_status.
agent_contributions.inventory: Dwight Schrute: confirmed 8 on hand, 12 short, Bulldog Print Co blocked by #501, restock $264; asked Oscar about funding. Tool: check_bulk_order_pricing.
agent_contributions.accounting: Oscar Martinez: recommended a modest 10% discount (not deeper), declined to request the $264 restock because it would leave −$104, gave the payment order (rent, then #501), and fact-checked Pam's draft. Tools: get_cash_position, list_payment_requests, check_bulk_order_pricing, assess_payment_request, get_ticket.
agent_contributions.customer_service: Pam Beesly: confirmed facts with Oscar, then saved draft #2 offering $52.20 each, 8 in stock now, no promise on the other 12; not sent. Tools: list_drafts, get_ticket, save_draft_message.

cash.database_check: SELECT * FROM cash_accounts → ('checking', 160.0, '2026-08-31'); payments table: 2 rows ($840 + $2,400), both approved_by David Wallace

rules_followed: Only gpt-6-luna through Portkey for every agent.
No agent paid anything; both payments were approved by David Wallace after logging in.
Cash never went negative ($160 at the end); the unaffordable $264 restock was never requested.
No emails or contact with real customers, landlords, or vendors; both messages are unsent drafts.
desk.date_today (2026-08-31) used for due dates and overdue checks.
The database was reset from the untouched original before the run.
